value.rationale: The source claims to optimize the probability distribution of controlled epidemic states and explicitly bases its control-to-state existence proof on the weak problem introduced through Equations (8)–(9). The mismatch is not a cosmetic sign: for exactly its Section 5 multiplicative incidence diffusion, Equation (8) corresponds to extra negative drift in both susceptible and infected coordinates, with an explicit nonzero infinitesimal mean error -0.02(1-alpha)^2SI(S+I). Equation (9) is separately inequivalent even with constant diffusion. This distinguishes which controlled probability law is being optimized and identifies the corrected conservation form and weak formulation needed to connect mathematical analysis to the stated stochastic model. No claim is made that the undisclosed numerical solver is wrong.
